description: This file defines a final class `Dropped` implementing `SendingOrDropped`, representing a dropped signal in the messaging system. It contains logic to monitor and acknowledge the dropped signal using a `ConnectionMonitor` and related context, primarily for logging or metrics purposes.

classes.name: Dropped
classes.description: Represents a dropped signal; contains context and message template, monitors dropped signals, and implements the `SendingOrDropped` interface.

methods.name: Dropped
methods.description: Constructor initializing the `Droppped` object with sending context and message template, checking for null arguments.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledge
methods.description: Monitors the dropped signal and acknowledges it using the `ConnectionMonitor`, returns an empty `Optional` of `CompletionStage<CommandResponse>`.
